item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—**upload a photo of your candle**, and I can turn it into a premium product shot while keeping the packaging and label recognizable.

My suggested direction: warm ivory tones, a stone surface, soft directional lighting, and subtle shadows—with the candle as the clear focal point. Clean and luxurious, without too many props.

If you don’t have a photo yet, tell me the candle’s name, vessel color, and scent, and I can create a concept shot instead.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with a concept shot—you can choose the candle’s name, vessel color, and scent, along with the brand and label wording. Your suggested visual direction sounds good; the main thing is that the scented candle looks premium. You can also choose the aspect ratio and platform, since I’m probably overthinking those details too.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the concept shot because your connected Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

The concept is ready:
- **Brand:** AUREL
- **Scent:** Amber & Sandalwood
- **Vessel:** Matte ivory ceramic with a minimal charcoal-text label
- **Setting:** Pale limestone, warm ivory backdrop, and soft directional light
- **Format:** Square, suited to Instagram

Once credits are available, we can use this direction to generate the shot.

approvals.name: generate_image

args.name: AUREL — Amber & Sandalwood Premium Candle Concept

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury scented candle product photograph for a premium Instagram brand launch, square composition. One hero candle, large and clearly dominant in frame: substantial matte warm-ivory ceramic cylindrical vessel with a refined thin rim and realistic ivory wax, single cotton wick, unlit. Minimal exquisite front label, perfectly facing camera, warm ivory paper with elegant dark charcoal typography and generous spacing. Label wording only: 'AUREL' on the top line, 'AMBER & SANDALWOOD' below, 'SCENTED CANDLE' in small type at bottom. Accurately spelled, restrained sophisticated typography. Candle rests on a honed pale limestone plinth against a seamless warm ivory studio backdrop. Beautiful soft directional window light from upper left, delicate elongated shadows, subtle warm glow, tactile ceramic and stone textures, exquisite realistic material detail. Restrained warm ivory, oat and taupe palette. Editorial luxury fragrance campaign, professional medium-format product photography, natural perspective, entire vessel and label sharply in focus with softly falling background focus. Balanced composition with generous breathing room above, candle occupies roughly two thirds of image height. No other products, no flowers, no scattered ingredients, no people, no hands, no promotional captions, no watermark. Make the candle feel premium through meticulous lighting, craftsmanship and simplicity rather than ornate decoration.
